File.name: 00-00-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It was the start of second semester when I first noticed her taking the same train as me.
All I knew was that she was from the class next door.
She seemed to like books. She was always reading on the train to and from school...
...and her classmates referred to her as 'Katsura'.
We just happened to take the same train every day. It was hardly a profound discovery...
...but ever since, I began to take an interest in her.
Of course, it's not as though\nI went around trying to find out about her,
and actually talking to her was out of the question.
But still, just watching Katsura from a distance was enough to make my day a little brighter.

File.name: 00-00-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, Makoto, have you heard the news?
They say we're going to be changing seats.
What? But we already changed seats at the beginning of the semester.
Yeah, but they say we're going to do it again.
Kioura heard it from Yamamoto this morning.
You know how first period is Yamamoto's class, right?
She said we're going to have a short-notice homeroom to change our seats.
Does your phone have a camera?
It's not exactly uncommon these days.
Well, yeah, but... my screen's still in black and white!
Both your parents and your sister are working, right?
So why are you still poor?
My dad got laid off, and my sister's pouring all her money into her long-distance relationship.
I wish I had one - with a camera, too.
You're not a girl, so it's not like you'll be using it a lot.
Have you heard about that charm you can do using the camera?
You take a picture of someone you like, and then you use that as your wallpaper.
Then, if you can keep anyone from seeing it for three weeks, you'll end up with her.
What, you never heard about it? It's pretty popular with the girls.
I don't really believe in stuff like that.
Yeah, so you say, but I'll bet your wallpaper's...
Damn, you hid it. So you really are...
It's not like that. I just don't want people looking at my phone.

File.name: 00-00-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Take a photo of the person you like, set it as your wallpaper... and wait three weeks, huh?
If I accidentally let someone see my phone...
People might think that I like Katsura...
Don't just look at someone else's phone like that!
This is my classmate, Saionji Sekai.
She's one of the cuter girls in our class, but she talks a little too much.
She's one of those girls who'd be popular if she'd just shut up.
What was that? Were you just thinking about how annoying I am?
That sharp perception of hers is a nuisance, too.
We'll be sitting next to each other from now on, won't we?
Hamaguchi's really fussy, so don't talk to me during class, okay?
Hey, can I ask you something?
You like Katsura-san from class 4, don't you?

File.name: 00-00-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "There's no need to hide it!\nAfter all, she's cute!!"
"You mean you're really going out with her?\nHyuu-hyuu-!!"
"How did you come to that conclusion!"
"You like her, don't you? So if you're not\nhiding it, you must be going out with her, right?'
"I'm not going out with her either!"\n- ...Aww, sheesh.

File.name: 00-00-A04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Sorry. I guess I got in the way..."

File.name: 00-00-A05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "I just happened to take a photo of her."

File.name: 00-00-A06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "That charm goes for three weeks!\nWhat day were you on?"
I told you, it's not like that...

File.name: 00-00-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Didn't you just tell me not to talk to you?
What are you, a kid?! That was because we were in class!
You idiot! Don't say it out loud!
You mean I can't tell anyone about it?
I'll kill you if you do.
Oh? Is that any way to address someone who knows your secret?
Isn't there a particular attitude to be adopted when you're asking someone for something?
Please... don't tell anyone about my phone.
Like hell I can calm down...
Sekai! Let's go and eat at the cafeteria!
Okay, I'll be right there! ...Ah, well, I'll see you later.

File.name: 00-00-B01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Just what is she up to...?
Could it be that she's already told someone...?

File.name: 00-00-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you doing, dragging me out to a place like this...?
This again? Haven't we settled this already?
I won't tell anyone, I promise! ...Are you happy now?
You're kind of scaring me, Itou.
I won't tell anyone else, starting from now.
You told someone, didn't you?!\nWas it Kanroji?! Or was it Yamagata?! Kuroda?!
Who did you tell?! Tell me!
Don't lie! You have, haven't you?!
I haven't told anyone, and I'm not going to.
If you understand, then get off me.
It looks like you're pushing yourself onto me. It'd be pretty bad if someone saw us like this.
Hey, why don't I give you a hand?
Yeah. First of all, I'll find out whether Katsura-san has a boyfriend.
I don't know. That's why I'm going to try and find out.
Basically, our final goal will be to set her up as your girlfriend.
I'm saying that I'll help you actually get somewhere with her.
I... I don't need your help!
Listen, the way I see it, the chances of you getting together with her right now are just about zero.
It takes more than a photo and some wishful thinking to get a girl, you know. It's looking pretty hopeless for you.
It's not as if... I want to go out with her or anything.
There you go again, getting angry to try and hide your embarrassment. You'll never get anywhere like that.
Still, the way I ended up sitting next to you and finding out about this... I guess you could call it fate.
Eheheh... just leave everything to Sekai-san.
If you won't, maybe I'll just tell everyone.
...All right. I'll leave it to you, Saionji.
'Sekai', like the word for 'world'. It's a big name, don't you think? I really like it.
But I guess it's kind of cool.
Haah... I feel like such an idiot.
I'm sorry I called you out here and yelled at you like that.
Well, it's good to be working with you, Makoto.
What, you're going to call me by my first name, too?
And so, our plan for me to get closer to Katsura was set into motion.

File.name: 00-00-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, I've got some big news today!
Look, just eat first. Here, have some strawberry milk.
Afterwards, the two of us tried to find out more about Katsura.
Katsura Kotonoha is in class 1-4. She likes to read, and she eats her lunch in the cafeteria every day.
It's usually ramen, with the occasional spaghetti. She probably likes noodles.
She's not good at P.E. Sometimes she gets anemic and just watches from the sidelines.
Classes 3 and 4 have P.E. together, so Sekai managed to gather some detailed information there.
Incidentally, she also checked Katsura out while they were changing, coming back to me with, 'Her breasts are huge!'
I really don't know how to respond to a report like that.
In any case, after all of that investigating, the two of us are now probably the biggest fans of Katsura in the entire school.
That's okay. After all, I'm on a diet. Do you want them?
Come on, give them a try. These are my specially made sandwiches.
If they're so special, then you shouldn't be leaving any behind.
Yeah. Do you make these by yourself every day?
My mother makes lunch for me, except on the days when she isn't working.
Doesn't your family make lunch for you?
Wow... oh, I know! Why don't I make some for you next time?
I can make rice balls and rice dishes, too.
Okay, I'll put everything I've got into it.
Come to think of it, you were saying something before we ate, weren't you?
Tada! I've become friends with Katsura-san!
Katsura-san was watching from the sidelines during P.E., so I pretended to be sick and took the period off with her.
Hey, it was for your sake. I found out a lot after talking to her today.
It seems that Katsura-san is so cute that she isn't fitting into her class.
That's why she's feeling lonely, because she hasn't been able to make many friends!
I managed to get her mobile number and her e-mail address, too! Am I amazing or what?
I'll pass them on to you, but you can't use them, okay?
I'm going to try and call her tonight. After that, I'll call you too.
This is kind of exciting, isn't it?
Yeah, I wasn't expecting you to just become her friend and get information straight out of her like that.
What are you talking about? Our goal is to make her your girlfriend, right?

File.name: 00-00-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've arranged to have lunch together with Katsura-san tomorrow.
It'll be at that place on the roof where we always eat lunch together!
Yeah. It looks so comfortable up there... I'm telling you, it'll be great.
I guess I'll be going to the cafeteria, then...
Huh?! What are you talking about? You're coming too.
I told Katsura-san that the three of us would be eating together.
You mean I'm going to have lunch too?
I'm not ready for something like that.
I can't do it. My legs start shaking as soon as I even think about it.
What are you talking about? If you're going to be like that, you'll never go out with her for the rest of your life!
...That's okay. I'll just spend my life watching her from afar.
I can't, I can't, I can't, I can't.
Guh... isn't 'die' going a little too far?
From Saionji Sekai\nSub You can die if you want
But if you're still alive by tomorrow,\nlunch is compulsory!!!! You've got to come!\nSekai-sama

File.name: 00-00-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Let's not do this after all.
Oh, stop fighting it! You've come this far!
I mean, I've already given up.
Ah! Come to think of it, I haven't done my report for physics.
Don't bring that up now! Besides, you can just skip physics.
Ah, that's right. I asked Katsura-san about the kind of guy she likes.
If you do, then you need to do this!
Katsura-san said that she doesn't have a boyfriend.
Really. Apparently, she lives in a really strict household,
and her dad's one of those people who absolutely refuses to let her go out with boys.
She said that there's this person she's interested in, but there's no one whom she'd go as far as to say she 'likes'.
Don't get depressed at every little thing. If you try your best, you've still got a chance.
Well, maybe just knowing that is enough for me...
Oh, stop whining and come with me!
L-look, it's fine... uwah! Stop dragging me!
Sorry about that. Did you wait long?
Hello... it's nice to meet you. I'm Katsura.
Aww... come on, don't be so shy! Now, let's have some lunch!
And so... for the first time,\nI was able to speak with Katsura,
the girl who I'd once just watched from a distance on the train.
To be honest, I was so excited at the time that I don't even remember what I ate...
But from that day onward, Sekai, Katsura and I came to eat lunch together every day.

File.name: 00-00-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm really grateful to you, Sekai.
What are you saying, all of a sudden?
I finally got to speak with the girl I used to just watch on the train...
and it's all thanks to you, Sekai.
I was content to just keep watching her forever like that.
If it wasn't for your help, I would have never made it this far.
I'm thinking of asking her out tomorrow.

File.name: 00-00-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Don't make me kick your butt.

File.name: 00-00-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She might turn me down... but I'm going to give it all I've got.
Whatever happens, I want to thank you, Sekai.
I just had this feeling that I had to tell you that first...

File.name: 00-00-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You catch this train too, don't you?
Ufufu... well, I suppose we are on the same line.
Listen... do you want to go to Sakakino-cho today after class?
You mentioned that you liked books... so I was thinking we could look around the bookstores in Sakakino-cho,
and then go to Sakakino Hills afterwards or something. How about it?
But I have to attend a student representative meeting, so I'll be a little late.
Saionji-san sent me an e-mail yesterday saying that she'd be busy today.
I was thinking... that we could go by ourselves.
Oh! I mean, it's fine if you don't want to... it's just that I...
you know... I mean... well, that is to say...
Um... would you really want to go with someone like me?
Yes, that's why I'm asking you.
I'll be looking forward to it.

File.name: 00-00-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, although it won't be for long, since she has her student rep meeting today.
What's wrong with that? You wouldn't last long on a first date, anyway.
Don't say that. Well, okay, I guess you could be right.
Are you going to meet her here after class?
No, we'll meet up on the platform.
Congratulations! That actually sounds kind of like a date!
Yeah, it was no problem... or so I'd like to say,
but you were the one who messaged her saying that you'd be busy after class, weren't you?
I'd be lost without you, Sekai.
Ahaha... with an attitude like that, I'm half expecting you to ask me to accompany you on your date.
Eh?! You'd do that for me?
I was just kidding. I'll be fine.

File.name: 00-00-K00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Have you already heard from Itou-kun?
What's this? Now you've got me all curious.
Well... Itou-kun asked me out on a date.
He said he'd be willing to go with someone like me...
He said that? Talk about rude.
Do you remember when I told you that there was a person I was interested in?
Of course, but you have to forget about him during your date. Makoto's a sensitive guy, so he'd get depressed.
That person I was interested in was Itou-kun.
It may just be a misunderstanding on my part, but every day on the train, I get the feeling that someone's watching me...
At first, I thought I was just being too self-conscious...
but as I began to think about it, I became more and more interested in him.
In that case, you both feel the same way about each other, right?
But I thought Itou-kun was going out with you, so I...
Yes, I found out this morning when he asked me out on that date.
I'm so grateful to you, Saionji-san.
If you hadn't brought us together, I don't think we would have ever had the chance to get to know each other...
After all, it takes more than wishful thinking to let someone know how you feel.
That's what I told Makoto, too.
He was all like, 'I'm happy just to watch her!'
Seriously, he's a really nice guy.
So give it your best, okay?

File.name: 00-00-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Heheh... don't get hasty and try to put the moves on her.
What are you doing here, Sekai? I'm telling you now, I don't need anyone to accompany me.
You idiot. I'm on this line too, you know.
No way. I've never seen you on the train before.
I come from the opposite side. My house is in Motehara-sakashita.
Well, I guess it doesn't matter.
Why are you doing this for me?
You know what I mean. We started off as nothing more than two people who happened to sit next to each other.
Well, Katsura-san was originally just someone you watched on the train.
Stop trying to dodge the question.
You didn't do all this for me just because you saw the picture on my phone.
I'm really grateful for what you've done... but why?
Yep. There's nothing more interesting than watching someone else's relationship grow, you know.
Look, most of the celebrity news shows and dramas on TV are all about romance, right?
A world made for just two people... ah, and I don't mean my name. I mean actual 'worlds'.
I want to toy with one with my own two hands!
You mean I'm being toyed with...?
...I kind of understand, and yet, I kind of don't.
Ufufu... well, that's how it is.
Haha... somehow, I get the feeling that I've just incurred a huge debt.
You bet. It's so huge that you won't be able to pay it back in this lifetime.
But you know, I will repay you one day.
Really? You don't have to force yourself, you know.
I'll repay you for sure. Whatever it takes, I'll do it.
Hmm... okay, maybe I will ask you for something in return.
Take your time and think it over. Look, here comes the train. Next time, you...
